_comment: Copy for /capabilities — written in processes and limits, not machines. Every numeric limit is a {token} resolved at build time from company.json (machine parameters / productionTerms), never a literal, so a corrected figure updates everywhere. Machines are referenced only as evidence, linked to /equipment. NO minimum order quantity, maximum, or volume threshold anywhere on this page — volume is discussed via the RFQ form. British English.

intro.heading: Capabilities
intro.body: One question decides whether we fit: does your part sit inside our process window? This page lays that window out — processes and limits, metal and wood. The machines behind the limits are on the equipment page.

_structureNote: Each process entry can later grow into a dedicated sub-page (href field, empty until the sub-page exists) without restructuring. Section IDs #metal, #wood, #complete-programmes are linked from the home page — keep them exactly.

processes.title: Cutting
processes.body: Tube {tubeRange} and profiles {profileRange}, up to {maxWall} wall thickness, in {metalMaterials}. Cutting tolerance to {cutTolerance} on automated tube cutting, at {throughput}.

processes.title: Bending
processes.body: Five-axis CNC bending of tube up to {bendTube} and profiles up to {bendProfile}, for complex multi-plane geometries. Hydraulic and semi-automated bending for larger sections — horizontal, vertical and variable radius. Three-roll bending for coils, arcs and rolled profiles.

image.src: [[TODO: /images/cap-bending.webp — REQUIRED SUBJECT: process shot, tube in the CNC bender]]

processes.title: Punching and forming
processes.body: Die cutting, hole punching and embossing with quick-change tooling. {pressForce} presses for forming operations. Dies are built in-house to the part.

processes.title: Welding
processes.body: Robotic welding on two Fanuc robots for repeatable seam geometry in series, plus manual welding for assemblies and prototypes.

processes.title: Surface preparation and coating
processes.body: Shot blasting for surface preparation and coating adhesion. Automated powder coating on a two-station line with pretreatment, drying, two powder chambers and two gas curing ovens — a second coat goes on without removing the part from the conveyor. Robotic sanding for surface finishing.

processes.title: Panel cutting and nesting
processes.body: CNC nesting and panel sawing with software-generated cutting plans, processing multiple panels per cycle. MDF, chipboard, plywood and solid timber.

processes.title: Machining
processes.body: CNC drilling, boring, milling and sawing on two-station machining centres. Spindle moulding, planing and thicknessing for solid timber components.

processes.title: Edgebanding
processes.body: Edgebanding at feed speeds {edgeSpeed} with pre-milling, glue application, edge trimming and polishing in one pass.

complete.title: Complete programmes
complete.opening: Most suppliers give you either the metal or the wood. A chair with a steel frame and a wooden seat then needs two suppliers, two quality standards, two lead times and an assembly step somewhere in between — usually yours.
complete.offer: Both chains run in the same facility, under one production plan and one quality chain. The frame is cut, bent, welded and powder coated; the seat or top is cut, machined, edged, sanded and painted; the parts meet for assembly and packing; one finished product leaves on one pallet, labelled under your brand.
removes: One supplier to qualify, audit and manage
One lead time instead of the longer of two
No inbound coordination between a metal and a wood supplier
Colour and finish matched across materials in-house, not across two companies
One shipment, one set of documents, one point of accountability
complete.close: Short runs and full series on the same equipment. A model can launch as a market test and scale to full volume without changing supplier or re-tooling.
